subject: Mobile Development
title: Samsung's Rise to the Top
description: A 60-second lesson on Samsung's Rise to the Top.

hook.text: Samsung was making washing machines and TVs. Then it bet everything on Android phones.

buildup.text: The Galaxy S series launched in 2010 with aggressive marketing and big, bright screens.

discovery.text: Samsung offered phones at every price point — from $50 to $1,000 — flooding every market.

twist.text: Apple sued Samsung for copying iPhone design. The lawsuit dragged on for seven years.

climax.text: Samsung became the world's largest phone maker by volume, outselling every rival.

punchline.text: A TV maker became the phone king.

quiz.question: What made Samsung the largest phone maker?
options: Phones at every price point on Android
